Arun: brief follow-up from the authz postmortem. listing owners + minimal success criteria so we can close loop quickly. pls ack.

Arun: ACTION ITEMS:
- Token validation: enforce expiry + signature check, add tamper/fuzz tests. owner: Nina. ETA: 2026-03-31. success: automated synthetic run shows 0 expired-token accepts over 72h. ticket: SEC-8001.
- Permission defaults: migrate to deny-by-default + migration job for legacy policies. owner: Theo. ETA: 2026-04-04. success: no app regressions in canary. ticket: SEC-8002.
- Audit logging: add `request_id,user_id,policy_version` to auth events; add missing-field alert. owner: Infra. ETA: 2026-03-28. success: >=99.9% coverage in staging logs. ticket: OPS-9009.
- Secrets rotation: runbook + automated staging rotation run and smoke tests. owner: Infra + Arun. ETA: 2026-04-07. success: rotation completes and smoke tests pass. ticket: OPS-9010.

Nina: ack. taking token validation. plan: middleware `authn/expiry_and_sig` + CI fuzz. will include clock skew scenarios. PR -> github.com/redwood/authn/pull/431.

Theo: ack. migration plan: add `legacy:true` flag, run rewrite job in read-only mode first to surface diffs, then apply. will run in a Dedicated canary region.

Infra: audit schema posted to internal docs. will add Splunk parser and an alert rule when `policy_version` missing. staging run tomorrow.

sec-bot: Created follow-up: <https://redwood.internal/incidents/1850012345>. Reminder: /remind #incidents in 5 days to update.

Arun: please update ticket with PR links when ready. we'll do a 10m demo next Mon to show tests + runbook. ping if blocked. :white_check_mark:
